## contratos-enviar-firma v1

Disparado por Kommo Salesbot al entrar lead en stage "Enviar a firma".

Flow:
1. Get Lead Kommo
2. POST /api/submissions a DocuSeal con template_id=1
3. Update lead con docuseal_submission_id + estado=enviado_firma
4. Move stage → Pendiente firma cliente
5. Email a Borja con links de firma

DocuSeal envía los emails a los firmantes automáticamente (send_email: true).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify([{ id: $("Extract Documenso URLs").first().json.lead_id, custom_fields_values: [  { field_id: 1375866, values: [{ value: String($("Extract Documenso URLs").first().json.submission_id) }] },  { field_id: 1375868,      values: [{ enum_id: 1025784 }] } ]}]) }}
={{ JSON.stringify([{ id: $("Extract Documenso URLs").first().json.lead_id, status_id: 106758499, pipeline_id: 13835643}]) }}

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: $('Idempotency Check').first().json.raw_lead }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify($json.url_patch_body) }}

={{ JSON.stringify([{ name: $('Build Custom Fields Update').first().json.vendor.name, custom_fields_values: [ { field_code: 'PHONE', values: [{ value: $('Build Custom Fields Update').first().json.vendor.phone, enum_code: 'WORK' }] }, { field_code: 'EMAIL', values: [{ value: $('Build Custom Fields Update').first().json.vendor.email, enum_code: 'WORK' }] } ] }]) }}
={{ JSON.stringify([{ to_entity_id: $json.vendor_contact_id, to_entity_type: 'contacts', metadata: { is_main: false, main_contact: false } }]) }}
={{ JSON.stringify([{ bot_id: 92046, entity_id: $('Build Custom Fields Update').first().json.lead_id, entity_type: 2 }]) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ _embedded: { contacts: [ { id: $('Vendor Contact Id').first().json.vendor_contact_id, is_main: true }, { id: $('Build Custom Fields Update').first().json.buyer.contact_id, is_main: false } ] } }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify([{ bot_id: 92048, entity_id: $('Build Custom Fields Update').first().json.lead_id, entity_type: 2 }]) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ _embedded: { contacts: [ { id: $('Build Custom Fields Update').first().json.buyer.contact_id, is_main: true }, { id: $('Vendor Contact Id').first().json.vendor_contact_id, is_main: false } ] } }) }}

parameters.name: payload
parameters.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({title: 'Contrato Simarro — Lead ' + $('Extract Drive FileId').first().json.lead_id + ' — ' + $('Unpack Lead').first().json.name, externalId: 'lead-' + $('Extract Drive FileId').first().json.lead_id}) }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify($json.recipientsPayload) }}
={{ JSON.stringify($('Documenso Build Fields').first().json.fieldsPayload) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ ({ ok: true, accepted: true, lead_id: $('Parse Kommo Payload').first().json.lead_id }) }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify([{ id: $('Parse Kommo Payload').first().json.lead_id, custom_fields_values: [ { field_id: 1375868, values: [{ enum_id: 1026916 }] } ] }]) }}
